project_context.app_type: Dashboard / SaaS App (Gestão Operacional de Marmitaria)
project_context.target_audience: Marmitaria owners, kitchen staff, delivery dispatchers

theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A food operations dashboard should avoid feeling like a sterile hospital or crypto exchange. We want a tactile, warm kitchen-management feel that pairs perfectly with food imagery.

rules.anti_default: Never use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.

rules.tints: Never use pure grey. Always use Tailwind 'stone' or 'orange/amber' tinted greys to maintain warmth.
rules.contrast: Text below 18px must have at least 4.5:1 ratio against background. Hover states must be explicitly defined.

spacing_and_layout.system: Tailwind standard scale, but skewed towards generous padding for layout and dense padding for operational data.

dashboard_grid.rules: Dense, scan-first layout. Top-left must show primary metric (Live Revenue/Orders). Use gap-4 or gap-6 for widgets.
dashboard_grid.cards: Subtle roundness (rounded-xl max). 1px border-stone-200. Very soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm). Do NOT overuse cards. Use flat lists where volume is high (e.g., order queues).

specific_customizations.buttons: rounded-lg, font-medium. Primary buttons use #C5533B. Avoid heavy shadows. Ensure explicit hover state.
specific_customizations.badges: Crucial for Order Status. Novo (Info), Em Preparo (Warning), Pronto (Success), Em Entrega (Brand/Accent), Concluído (Neutral Dark), Cancelado (Danger).
specific_customizations.tables: Go cardless for large datasets. Use border-collapse with border-b border-stone-200. Left-align text, right-align numbers/currency.
specific_customizations.dialogs: Use soft glassmorphism backdrop (backdrop-blur-sm bg-stone-900/40) for modals.

motion.rules: Minimalist and functional. Micro-interactions for feedback.
motion.hover_states: Buttons and list items should have a fast background color transition (duration-200 ease-in-out).
motion.page_transitions: Fade in content on route change to avoid harsh jumps.

login_background.usage: Use as a full-bleed background for the login/auth split screen layout. Apply a slight gradient overlay (bg-stone-900/20) if text needs to go over it.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React.js (.js/.jsx files only, NO TypeScript), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_requirements: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='order-status-badge').
instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Build a layout with a fixed left Sidebar and a scrolling main content area. Implement an intuitive 'Kanban' or 'List' view for the active order queue.
instructions_to_main_agent.language: All UI text, labels, statuses, and dummy data MUST be in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_usage: Do NOT use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Always install and use shadcn/ui DropdownMenu, Select, Calendar, etc. Provide proper aria-labels.
instructions_to_main_agent.mock_data: Use the provided image URLs for product photos. Do not use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
